description:
Retire the private memory-backed setups of the `fast_docs_templates` suite.

## Background

Shared test support builds a memory store and executor from declarations passed as data, on top of the shared memory executor. Helpers that act on a `TestHarness` or executor they are given are scenario steps, not setups. 

Helpers to retire, from the mechanical sweep in investigation §D.6 (function names are the identity; lines at `a5aac64b1`):

- `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/template_apply_atomicity_tests.rs`: `memory_storage` (`:380`).
- `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/template_binding_tests.rs`: `executor_with_templates` (`:106`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each helper under "Helpers to retire" no longer exists, and the tests that called it obtain what it built from the shared fixtures.
- [hard] REQ-02: No file in `fast_docs_templates` defines a function that constructs an `InMemoryStorage` or a memory executor; no test writes an index body or restates a value product initialisation already writes, and scenario values (for example `enforce_leases = "off"`) reach the shared constructor as declarations.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each affected test asserts what it asserted before.
title: fast_docs_templates memory-backed tests use the shared seeding
